fusions.name: Spitting Shot
fusions.desc: A jet of water that deals 7 damage, up to 2 times as much at maximum range. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Deep Charge
fusions.desc: Fires a charge that detonates on the first enemy it meets, dealing 35 damage to it and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Long Pressure
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 54% further.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: When your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
